acceptance: Local InfluxDB 3 Core SF0.01 runs load every UAT benchmark that the platform manifest claims for InfluxDB, and each cell passes or carries a documented skip naming a reproduced engine error
InfluxDB is back in the release-UAT timeseries shard, with floors updated and a passing dry run
Harness passes core-mode connection options (from the release-UAT harness fix) and the adapter creates the database on connect
context: Dry run 2 (run 41163626947): 21 InfluxDB cells failed. The 'No token / Cloud mode' connection failure is fixed by the harness change in fix/uat-harness (#3885, folded into the release integration PR). After that fix, 20 of 21 cells still stop at load.
description: InfluxDBAdapter.load_data loads only TSBS DevOps data. Other benchmarks connect to a local InfluxDB 3 Core but fail with 'Required benchmark tables are missing or empty after load'. For 0.5.0 the owner removed InfluxDB from release UAT (decision 2026-10-31). This item adds a general loader (table creation and ingest for the TPC and other UAT benchmark schemas, through line protocol or the SQL/Arrow ingest path InfluxDB 3 Core supports), then runs every UAT benchmark InfluxDB can execute. Benchmarks the engine cannot express get documented skips that cite the engine error. Finally InfluxDB returns to the timeseries release-UAT shard.
